title: Child Health
description: This study (both document review and gap assessement) helps to identify the root causes for low performance in manamgent of common neonatal and childhood illness while the protyping phase helps to design and test the appropriate intervention modalities for the improvement of the services by HEWs.

title: BIRCH
description: This project will support the MOH to incorporate and track GC7 priorities into the annual woreda based operational plan, institutionalize annual HEP maturity assessment, scaling up of blended learning, resource mapping and conducting funding gap analysis for HEPO as well as generate evidence on the implemenation status of sutainable financing for HEP.

title: RMNCH
description: Blended learning approach was piloted in selected eCHIS implementing 20 Woredas using RMNCH module. This project aims at further scaling up of the blended learning approach using RMNCH module to developing regions of Ethiopia to reach additional 400 HEWs.

title: NCD/MCD
description: There are a number of challenges associated with traditional IRT incuding less interactive content, delivered face to face for longer duration and incurring huge cost. Blended training have been piloted in 20 woredas using RMNCH module. The training was found to be cost effective with remarkable skills improvement. Scaling up of refresher training on NCD and MCD modules is MOH priority for this year and LMH has planned to support this MoH effort. Therefore, the training will help in addressing the resource constraints faced to scale up the two modules to larger number of HEWs with interactive, cost-effective and efficient training approach.
